findings.title: G6 statistical input validation coerced malformed replicate and oracle alignment fields
findings.evidence: Before this cycle, analyze_g6_clustered.py applied int(row['replicate']), so a string replicate or boolean could be silently coerced into a formal arm key. It also did not validate private-oracle cf_type against the plan's case CF. A read-only synthetic probe with a malformed replicate was accepted, and a private row with cf_type=CF2 for a plan case in CF1 was accepted. The design requires typed frozen-plan replicate fields and paired counterfactual/oracle identities.
findings.remediation: Require typed nonempty plan identifiers and integer non-boolean replicate values; reject inconsistent CF mappings within a case; require private oracle case_id/cf_type/expected_decision fields to be valid and aligned with the plan before summaries. Do not rewrite historical artifacts.
